effects_provenance.raw: Gelato – THCa Flower 14G Click here for COA Gelato is like the cool kid in the cannabis world. It’s also known as Gelato 33 or Larry Bird (Gelato 41). It’s the perfect mix of two incredible parent strains: Sunset Sherbet and Thin Mint Girl Scout Cookies. Gelato is the best of both worlds! It’s an Indica-dominant hybrid—56 % indica, 44% Sativa—which means it offers relaxation while also having that Sativa-focused kick. Whether you’re new to cannabis or a seasoned pro, it’s the kind of strain that leaves you wanting more every single time! Strain Effects Euphoric high Uplifting Creative Relaxing effects Happy Focused THC Level The THC level for this Indica-dominant hybrid is 14.41%. Its mildy high THC content can be attributed to the densely populated trichomes adding to the potency of this excellent cannabis bud. The strain’s potency adds to its appeal for cannabis enthusiasts. Aroma & Flavor Profile Gelato is a sweet and fruity mix with a hint of gas, drawing you closer with its irresistible aroma. It has been described as a scoop of sherbet reminiscent of blueberry and orange flavors. As you inhale, it’s like entering a world filled with lavender, citrus, and berries! When you break apart the nugs and light up, a subtle woody note enhances your overall smoking experience. It’s like taking a flavorful journey with every puff! Appearance At first glance, gelato has slightly dense, dark purple buds with super bright pistil orange hairs covered in thick, crystal-like trichomes. Trichomes are the good stuff, containing cannabinoids and terpenes that give Gelato its high-quality, distinct flavor and potency!
